rationale: Both Shiza and Jake are hands-on founders building in robotics with complementary skill sets—Shiza brings mechanical engineering, haptics, and applied ML expertise from 1X and her current work at Haptile, while Jake is focused on robot arm development and infrastructure optimization at the lowest levels of the stack. They share a conviction that robotics deployment requires operators and builders who can move fast in public, and could explore synergies between Haptile's haptics-robotics work and Thompson Labs' manipulation robotics focus.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Jake Fitzgerald — you're both building robots in the physical world with deep conviction about infrastructure and hands-on execution; Shiza's background in haptics and ML at 1X could complement Jake's focus on low-level compute optimization for robot systems.
